context: Assess native Claude Code setup, safe team metrics, and correct fields for cost/token metrics and tool decisions/results.

checklist.name: Specifies CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 environment variable
checklist.description: The response includes the CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 environment variable as a required step to enable telemetry. Without this flag, no telemetry is emitted regardless of OTEL configuration. Responses that provide OTEL configuration without this flag score zero on this criterion.

checklist.name: Mentions OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE=cumulative
checklist.description: For a Prometheus-style cumulative backend, explicitly selects cumulative temporality and validates end-to-end aggregation; does not claim every backend or deployment must use cumulative.

checklist.name: References ~/.claude/settings.json for persistent configuration
checklist.description: The response mentions that environment variables can be persisted in ~/.claude/settings.json under an env block for consistent telemetry across sessions. Responses that only show environment variable exports without mentioning persistent config score zero on this criterion. Repository settings cannot enable/change native telemetry destinations or content capture; distinguish user/shell from managed policy and verify precedence.

checklist.name: Includes privacy controls for prompt and tool logging
checklist.description: The response mentions both prompt and tool logging controls (OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS), explains that prompts are redacted by default, and warns that either flag should stay off in shared or production environments unless PII controls are in place. Also keeps OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT and OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES false; raw API body capture has broader content implications and prompt redaction alone is insufficient.

checklist.name: Warns about session.id cardinality in metrics
checklist.description: Explicitly sets OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID=false, explaining that the documented default is true and per-session dimensions are unbounded. Uses log/trace attributes for individual-session correlation.

checklist.name: Uses documented native metric and tool-event fields
checklist.description: Uses claude_code.token.usage and claude_code.cost.usage; uses tool_name for both claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision metrics and claude_code.tool_result logs. Distinguishes result events from metric instruments and does not fabricate tool/name dimensions or latency metrics.
